data.name: Mighty Ambush*
data.description: Once per round, when the vigilante succeeds at a hidden strike, he can instantly drop the damaged enemy unconscious for 1d4 rounds. A successful Fortitude saving throw negates this effect (DC %1). Whether or not a creature's saving throw is successful, it can't be affected by that vigilante's mighty ambush again for 24 hours.|10+VigilanteTalentLVL/2+MAX(STR,DEX)
